scientific_integrity: All 65,536 Walsh multipliers and Fourier-support kernel coefficients were checked by exact-integer algorithms; two independent methods produce identical complete signed histograms. The optimal projection norm additionally follows from an analytic translation-averaging argument.
scientific_limitations: Exact evaluated nullity and endpoint projection norms concern only the Boolean lattice on four ground elements.
The 168-point antichain-incidence embedding is not the truth-table embedding of monotone Boolean functions.
No general-order spectrum or asymptotics is asserted; independent validation and exhaustive historical priority review are not performed.
title: Exact Walsh rank and optimal endpoint projection for four-variable antichains
